units.source_text: 她觉得对母亲也很可恋念。

en.t: She felt that even her mother was very dear and much to be longed for.

units.source_text: 平时并不特别关心而相貌丑陋的弟妹，也很可恋念。

en.t: Even the younger brothers and sisters, ugly and usually of no special concern to her, now seemed very dear.

units.source_text: 又想起匂亲王夫人二女公子……愿得今生再见一面的人很多。

en.t: She also thought of Prince Niou's wife and the Second Princess; there were many people she wished she could see once more in this life.

units.source_text: 众侍女准备薰大将来迎接，忙于缝衣染帛，说东谈西，但在浮舟听来全不入耳。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting were preparing for General Kaoru to come and fetch her, busy sewing clothes, dyeing silk, and chatting about this and that, but none of it reached Ukifune's ears.

units.source_text: 到了晚上，她就考虑办法，如何可以避免人目而走出门去。

en.t: When night came, she began thinking of some way to slip out the door without being seen.

units.source_text: 因此通夜不眠，心绪恶劣，元气尽失。

en.t: Because of this she could not sleep all night, her mind in turmoil and all her strength gone.

units.source_text: 到了白天，她就向宇治川眺望，觉得死期比步入屠场的羊更近了。

en.t: By day, she gazed toward the Uji River and felt that her death was nearer than that of a sheep walking into the slaughterhouse.
